Version 1.1.0: updated Settings panel and update tools.
First release.

Plain Format: the one-card 'Choose a Template' dialog is gone (Professional Nonfiction is used directly). Word export fixed: page numbers now appear in the footer, no stray blank first page, chapters start on new pages.

The bin button in the panel header is now Reset everything. It asks for a second click to confirm, then clears this plugin's saved data (Sources list and labels, loaded video and transcript, outline, chapter summaries, progress and book settings) and reloads the panel fresh. It only touches Tube2book's own data, never other plugins, quota or license.

One Chapter per Video fix, now actually included (1.1.3 was published without it). Every section (Introduction, each chapter, Conclusion) is written only from the video labelled for it: each prompt says exactly which section to write and to ignore every other source, and a section with no transcript-ready video stops with a clear message instead of reusing the open video. Also fixes the progress notes in prompts showing a stale chapter count and saying the Introduction was completed while writing it.

One Chapter per Video: every section (Introduction, each chapter, Conclusion) is now written only from the video labelled for it. Fixes chapters all being written from a single video. Each prompt now tells the AI exactly which section to write and to ignore every other source, and a section with no transcript-ready video stops with a clear message instead of quietly reusing the open video.

Tube2book: new Sources list. Add as many YouTube videos as you like, label each one (Introduction, Chapter 1, Chapter 2 ... Conclusion), and write the book one section at a time from them. Get transcripts in place for one video or all at once, with a guide that shows the next step, balanced full-width section tabs, and one-chapter-per-video writing that uses each section's own videos. The Add button on YouTube video cards needs app 1.2.7.
Shared page engine update: more reliable PDF export and page decorations.

plugins.name: Workbook
plugins.description: Prompt writer, page generator and KDP multi-page canvas.

changelog.notes: Workbook now has a Book language, like Cookbook Writer Pro. The plugin and the prompts stay in English; only what is printed on the pages changes language. Prompt Writer: pick from 35 European languages or type any language, and the prompt tells the AI to write all printed text natively (not translated), including the front pages. Puzzle pages: labels, titles, standard instructions and colour names are built in for Spanish, French, German, Italian and Portuguese, and any other language can be added with one copy-and-paste translation request that is then saved. Month and weekday names come from locale data for every language, months can be typed in your language, and the week starts on Monday for non-English languages (changeable). Word search, crossword, cryptogram and scramble now work with accented, Cyrillic and Greek letters.

Workbook Puzzle pages now builds 62 page types in software, so every line, letter, number and date is exact and stays inside the KDP content zone (each page is text-checked before it is added). Puzzles and games: word search, sudoku, dot-to-dot, crossword, maze, word scramble, cryptogram, maths worksheet, bingo, matching, counting, colour-by-number (mystery picture from your artwork), spot-the-difference (picture B made from your artwork) and board game, plus riddles and quiz. Activities: flashcards, handwriting, tracing. Fixed layouts: journals, daily and weekly planners, habit, budget, expense, fitness, workout, mood, reading, sleep and water trackers, goals, to-do, checklist, monthly and year calendars with correct dates, password log, guest book, notebook, dot grid, graph and music paper, Cornell notes, storyboard, comic, bullet journal, certificate, title, belongs-to, dedication, thank-you, chapter and section pages, closing and quote pages. The Prompt Writer adds Colour-by-number and Counting page types and a Build this page with software button.

Workbook: new Puzzle pages tool and a Fit in safe area button. Puzzle pages (KDP Canvas tab) builds word search, sudoku and dot-to-dot pages where software draws every letter, number and grid: word lists are placed exactly once, every sudoku has one solution, and every piece of text is checked against the KDP content zone before the page is added. An AI picture can sit behind the puzzle. The Prompt Writer can now ask the AI for artwork only for those three types. Fit in safe area (toolbar, and per page) scales a whole image to sit inside the green safe line and leaves the rest of the page white, in the preview, export and PDF.

Workbook Prompt Writer: protected white margin. Every page now has a content zone that holds all artwork and text (worked out from your trim size, margin and page count) and a protected white exclusion zone around it that the AI must leave empty, so nothing can run to the page edge or into the bleed. Prompts now list every piece of text that appears and forbid any other writing. New Empty outer band setting (pure white or very light decoration). Page-type specs updated to match.

Workbook Prompt Writer: every page type now has its own detailed specification (83 types). The prompt you paste into ChatGPT now spells out that type's exact layout, counts, sizes, printed text and blank areas instead of one generic line, for example the full grid and word list for a word search, the given digits for a sudoku, and the 8 by 31 grid for a habit tracker. Page types that only work as line art (coloring pages, mazes, puzzle grids, graph paper and similar) are printed as black line art automatically, a hint under the Page type list shows what each type asks for, and custom page types ask the AI to state the full structure.
